items.english: What would make you reject a seed plant even if its fruit were large?
items.draft: Yintoni enokukwenza wale isityalo sembewu nokuba isiqhamo saso sikhulu?
items.backtranslation: What can you do of this seed plant even if its fruit is big? (garbled, no reject sense)
items.problem: Ungrammatical; the question about what would make you reject the plant is lost.
items.corrected: Yintoni enokukwenza uwale isityalo sembewu nokuba isiqhamo saso sikhulu?

items.english: Point out the plants you would select and the plants you would reject.
items.backtranslation: Point out plants you could choose and ones you could give birth to / breed from.
items.problem: ongazizala = breed/give birth to, the opposite of reject (selection logic reversed).

items.english: Crops pollinated by wind or insects can cross over long distances.
items.backtranslation: ...by wind or are insects can mix over a long distance.
items.problem: Ungrammatical copula (zizinambuzane = they are insects) instead of agent 'by insects'.
items.corrected: Izityalo eziphiwa uthuli lwentyatyambo ngumoya okanye ngeenambuzane zinokuxubana ngomgama omde.
